description.narrative: Definition and implementation of locally based and prioritized activities related to the need for climate adaptation, through the environmental network LIDEMA and its base organizations.
Definition och genomförande av lokalt baserade aktiviteter inom prioriterade områden för klimatanpassning, via det nationella miljönätverket LIDEMA och dess basorganisationer.

To develop and validate replicable measures for reduction of livelihood vulnerabilities due to climate change at the grass-roots level and to strengthen local organisations and administrative levels for enhancing their capacity to assume responsibility for planning for efforts to adapt to climate change.

Summary of results 2016: Summary of results achieved during 2016: The criteria for the selection of models to evaluate was based on the methodological guide "Deterimation of replicable models and adaptation projects to climate change". The evaluation was carried out through focus Group discussions and interviews with key stakeholders Selected conclusions: The gender strategy and the analysis of gender roles and distribution of responsibilities between men and women was not adequately developed and led to the majority of the Groups being male dominated In the majority of the models there were a weakness in the collaboration with the municipalities which causes the interventions to unlink from municipality plans. In three of the evaluated models the link remains strong and the models are reappearing in the operational plans of the municipalities which was seen important for the sustainability A stronger coordination in the models with other territorial entities would have permitted more efficient processes for capacity building, organisation, production and commercialization. The production aspects of the models seemed more important to the participating families than the aspects of climate change and resilience. This ex-post evaluation has been a valuable exercise for LIDEMA in understanding the course the programme results and activities take after the programme period. Lessons learnt that will help LIDEMA in future programme planning and implementation. Summary of results 2015: As a result of Lidema´s programme on adaptation to climate change an increasing number of small-holder farmers, local communities and municipalities have reduced their vulnerability to climate change. Since the start 1561 families in the programme area of 22 municipalities, have participated and benefitted from the 14 models of implementation in increasing capacity to adapt to climate change
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
